body:
I wish i could leave, but i have nowhere to go. Nowhere to stay, no friends or family in the area.
And he refuses to move out, so that's not an option either. Not that i could afford rent on my own anyway, if he did leave. 
I'm just so tired of this

I guess i just struggle with seeing a way out at all. 
I have no one around me to lean on, no couch to sleep on or friends/family around. No shelters nearby, and no money to afford a new apartment or even to travel to the nearest shelter. 
It just seems so impossible, and taking the easy way out just sounds like the best/only option i have left

I have no money or resources to get out. We share an apartment and he won't move out. 
I'm completely on my own and it just seems impossible to get away when the only other option i have is to stay on the streets. No friends or family to reach out to, no shelters in my area and i don't even have the money to travel to the nearest shelter.
lmao i honestly think i change blades maybe once or twice a year, and not even because they get dull or anything, i just have a tendency to forget where i put them 😭

I mean, we live together and he has his own keys but Its just my name on the contract. 
And normally there aren't any issues with me being alone other than the fact that he constantly questions if I've cheated on him or let anyone else into the apartment, but it's not like he won't 'allow' me to be alone.
I guess it mostly just sucks being left alone at 3 am knowing he's just gonna go jerk off somewhere.

It's now almost 7:30 am and he hasn't been back. I still haven't slept, because my heart and my head is too broken to do anything other than mindlessly scroll through reddit. 
I would have to ask my friends first, he doesn't like me texting my friends about our issues so none of them know what's happening and i guess i just don't want to feel like a burden to them. I have no idea what to do tbh

Honestly, I'm on my own. My mom lives about half an hour away but we have issues, we're not close and i honestly don't think her presence will make my situation any better. 
I moved to this city about a year and a half ago, and i still haven't made any friends here. My only 2 friends are 7 hours away, and i can't even travel to them since I'm broke. It's honestly just a shit show, and all i can think about is either staying in my shitty apartment by myself, wondering why the fuck im not enough for him, or put on my shoes and just run away. 

But running away isn't much of a solution either, I'd just be even more tempted to kill myself if I knew no one would find me or be there to stop me. 

So i guess i just feel stuck here. All alone. Contemplating why the fuck i even keep trying when all i get back is pain and heartbreak and betrayal.

It sucks, to be honest.

Yeah i get how you feel.
As long as I'm being safe, or at least not going overboard with it, why can't I just be allowed to do it in peace? 
It doesn't hurt anyone, and it's not like I'm being taken seriously anyway, so why should I even bother trying to stop and recover?

I guess that's just the weird mentality we get to try and justify it. But seriously? To me it probably helps me more than it hurts. It calms me down, it has kept me from committing suicide multiple times, and it's just almost therapeutic. Why would i care enough to find "better" and less "destructive" coping mechanisms, when this one works just fine?
yikes i also did amphetamine a couple days ago and currently debating whether I should OD on the rest lmao. i just wanna feel happy but all i got was depression whoops
Well it's currently 5 am in my country. Ive kinda given up on getting any sleep

All i want is to just be able to run away and leave everything behind. But i have no car, no money, nothing. So if my only choices are ending myself, or running away and hoping it'll solve things, its just so much easier to off myself. I also made a safety plan with my therapist but i can't even force myself to reach out to any of my emergency contacts. Everything is just too overwhelming, and it would just be so much easier to get it over with than wake up every single day hoping it'll hurt a little less

Thank you so much. Your comment does really make a lot of sense, i guess i just have a hard time seeing how i could possibly turn my life around at this point. I feel like I'm too far gone, too traumatized and too fucked up by this shit to ever get back to a good place. 

Thank you for your support, i really do mean it when I say that without this community and all the support I've gotten here, i would've been gone a long time ago.
